Context: 12. Relaxation of consultation norms in respect of CGHS beneficiaries aged 75 years and above

- (iv) Primary cardholder beneficiaries aged 75 and above shall be permitted to undergo 'Annual Health Check-up' at empanelled hospitals for which permission will be granted by CMO lncharge  
of the Wellness Centre. Private hospitals empanelled under CGHS shall perform the Annual Health Check-up at CGHS rates and extend cashless facility. - OM, dated 19-8-2019.
